test_title: PYST 44: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. All numbers are single-digit numbers.

(Left) # 9 & 5 1 © * * * @ # & 7 & # $ 8 & 3 1 @ € (Right)

How many such symbols are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) # 9 & 5 1 © * * * @ # & 7 & # $ 8 & 3 1 @ € (Right)

Now,

Symbols, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, the needed pattern is: Number — Symbol — Number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbb964dea439365bdfd5a8dbfe2f78db39dd725e3ab3c78f66dd36533eaf5aed.png] Thus, there are 2 such symbols, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
